title: Esrbespoke page hero
description: An inner page's opening on paper: a tall white band (616px) with a two-line title at the bottom left (at a third of the way down on phones), a short note in tiny capitals at column 9 that types itself on, and a down arrow at the right; then a full-width photo (portrait on phones, 16:10 on desktop) that rises into place on load and drifts with the scroll.
notes: leaves room at the top for the absolute header
the note types on with JavaScript (hydrate: visible); without it the text is simply shown
parallax and rise are CSS (scroll-driven inside @supports), off under reduced motion
